title: Speaking: Interview Reasons and Examples
focus: Sustentar opiniões com razões e exemplos
verifiableTask: Responder quatro perguntas com posição, razão e exemplo

content.text: Ao final da aula você consegue:
dar opiniões sobre temas de educação, tecnologia e sociedade em 30–45 segundos, de forma organizada.
responder quatro perguntas com posição, razão e exemplo.
Phones should be banned in classrooms.
Online classes are as good as in-person classes.
How do you usually spend your weekends?
When I was in high school,…
Of course, there are some drawbacks, but…
Ouça e repita, enfatizando a palavra em maiúsculas:
It's not ONLINE classes that are bad, it's BAD online classes.
I strongly believe that online classes are flexible and affordable.

questions.questionText: I'm in ______ of a four-day school week. (a favor)

explanations.general: I'm in favor of a four-day school week.

options.text: over a long period of time

explanations.general: Correct answer: over a long period of time

questions.questionText: Which word means “that you can pay for”?
One ______ of online classes is that you can study anywhere. (benefício)

explanations.general: One benefit of online classes is that you can study anywhere.

options.text: I believe that it is important.

explanations.A: Falta o sujeito: that it is.
explanations.general: Correct answer: I believe that it is important.

questions.questionText: Phones can be a big ______ in class. (distração)

explanations.general: Phones can be a big distraction in class.

content.text: — 1 razão bem explicada é melhor que 3 razões soltas.
— retome a posição em poucas palavras.
Do you think students should be allowed to use phones in class?
Personally, I think phones should be allowed, but only for specific activities.
The main reason is that phones can be really useful learning tools — you can look up words, take photos of the board or answer online quizzes.
For example, my English teacher in high school used a quiz app, and the whole class became much more engaged.
So, with clear rules, phones can help more than they distract.
O aluno fala junto com o professor (sombra) e depois responde com a opinião oposta.
→ school uniforms / they reduce social pressure → free public transport / it reduces traffic → learning a second language at school / it opens doors in the job market
→ banning video games / they can develop skills → long lectures / people lose focus after 20 minutes
Para cada opinião, dê um exemplo concreto (lugar, pessoa, momento):
Group work helps students learn. 2. Living alone teaches responsibility. 3. Social media can be harmful.

options.text: Personally, I think phones should be allowed for specific activities.
Phones exist in the modern world.
There are many opinions about phones.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Personally, I think phones should be allowed for specific activities.

options.text: Because it lets students study at their own pace.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Because it lets students study at their own pace.

options.text: When I lived alone in Curitiba, I learned to pay all my bills on time.

explanations.general: Correct answer: When I lived alone in Curitiba, I learned to pay all my bills on time.

questions.questionText: The main reason ______ that it saves time. (é)

explanations.general: The main reason is that it saves time.

questions.questionText: Of course, there are some drawbacks, ______ I still think it's worth it. (mas)

explanations.general: Of course, there are some drawbacks, but I still think it's worth it.

questions.questionText: Giving one well-explained reason is better than listing three reasons without explanation.

content.text: O professor faz cada pergunta; o aluno tem
Some people say that university education should be free for everyone. Do you agree?
Is it better to work for a large company or a small one?
Should children learn to use computers before they learn to write by hand?
Do you think people today spend too much time on their phones?
P ☐ R ☐ E ☐ por pergunta · tempo · 1 erro de gramática
o professor escolhe 1 pergunta. O aluno responde
Escreva 3 começos de posição, 3 de razão, 3 de exemplo. Leia em voz alta.
Escreva sua posição + razão para 6 temas: educação gratuita, home office, redes sociais, uniforme, transporte público, esporte na escola.
Responda perguntas 1 e 2 da tarefa. Escute: tem P-R-E?
Grave uma resposta defendendo uma opinião que não é sua.
Fale junto com o modelo da seção 3 até ficar natural.

questions.questionText: I'm ______ banning video games; they can develop skills. (contra)
A good ______ is my cousin, who learned English with games. (exemplo)

explanations.general: A good example is my cousin, who learned English with games.

options.text: I agree with this idea because is useful.
I agree with this idea because it is useful.
I am agree with this idea.

explanations.general: Correct answer: I agree with this idea because it is useful.
